package.name: image_view2
package.description: Stopgap ROS 2 port of the image_view2 messages used by jsk_rqt_plugins. The MouseEvent definition is identical to the ROS 1 package (https://github.com/jsk-ros-pkg/jsk_common). Only the message is provided; the image_view2 node itself is not ported. Remove this package once an official ROS 2 release of image_view2 exists.
